description: On any change touching .claude-plugin/, parses .claude-plugin/plugin.json with python3 to confirm the manifest is syntactically valid JSON; regulates maintainability of the plugin entry point. Output is single — exit 0 means the manifest parses, anything else means the plugin loader will reject it. Auto-detected via /detect-sensors from .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
